The negative control is executed and logged: with the base revision's baseline filter the unpromoted run does not appear and the test fails. Test files naming follow, rearm, _row_is_stale_inventory or settled_at_attach are recorded as flat baseline_suite and after_suite records.
node_definition.goal: Make a-follower-outlives-its-monitor §4 hold as its section states. Each session's last delivered state per run is persisted in a sidecar file in follower_dir named for the session with the suffix .delivered.json, written whenever the follower writes a row to the pane. A follower attaching for a session with a record first emits one header line (re-attached, live runs found, runs changed since the recorded time), then the owning session's runs whose classifier state differs from the record, as transitions from the recorded state, with a run the record does not name replayed from dispatched. _row_is_stale_inventory in reckon/cli.py no longer suppresses completed_unpromoted, failed or abandoned rows; a promoted run stays suppressed; SETTLED_STATES keeps its value.
